text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One evening, Tamamo Cross and I are strolling through the shopping district, munching on croquette​s, when…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's goin' on over there? They've got a huge crowd…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! You there, the li'l girl in the back! Care to give it a spin?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, who ya callin' "li'l girl"?! I'm not some kiddo, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Seriously though, Mister, ya got some guts callin' on me. I hope your jaw's ready to hit the floor 'cause I'm takin' every prize ya got!
choice_data_list: We've only got one ticket, though…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What?! Just one?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever. Let's nab the best prize and put some tears in this raffle fella's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Trainer. Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We pull the lever together and spin the tumbler at lightning speed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What the—it's just some ticket? I was hopin' for some food…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait whaaaaat?! Hot springs?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-you're joking…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Seriously? A hot spring vacation?!
choice_data_list: What, would you've preferred a cold spring vacation?
What, would you've preferred a cold spring vacation?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Can it, idiot! I'm the one with the comebacks!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But… wh-what am I s'posed to do with this? I went and won the grand prize…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But I haven't got the slightest clue what to do with it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her tough talk earlier, Tamamo Cross ends up putting tears in her own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I used to beg and beg for a hot spring trip when I was a kid, but I never got to go…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What am I s'pposed to do now? I can't accept this…
choice_data_list: Should we give it back, then?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Heck no! We struck gold here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait! Why don't you hold onto the tickets for me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And then I can win it back. Nothin' wrong with a winner earnin' a free trip, right? That's what they do in the comedy grand prix!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It'll be my reward when I dominate the Twinkle Series. Not bad, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Awesome, it's a deal then! Boy… Me, goin' on a hot spring vacay? Is Lady Luck finally lookin' my way?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, I can't start countin' my chickens yet. I gotta work real hard if I'm gonna cash out my prize!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snapping back to reality, Tamamo Cross pumps herself up. Her desire to win is as steaming hot as the soothing baths she dreams of visiting.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I just won the mother of all burgers! I'm eatin' good today!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But it is kinda funny-lookin'. It's got a big ol' carrot pokin' out of it…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Why'd they go stabbin' a veggie into the meat, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A carrot… stabbed into the steak… steak… Stake!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Staked the… They staked the steak…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! There's no way that's the reason—or it'd mean there's someone servin' up puns as bad as yours!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Phew… All that jokin' around's got me starvin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Let's take this 'n head back to the dorms! We're havin' ourselves a feast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We enjoy a jolly dinner as we pick away at the deluxe carrot hamburger steak we won.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoooa, all these carrots are for us? Now that's what I'm talkin' about!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This portion's HUGE… It's freakin' mountain-sized! And "mountain-sized" is one of my favorite words!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yep. Right up there with "half off" and "bargain."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Okay, so I'm thinkin' we split 'em and send half to my fam.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll write 'em a little note like, "Check what I won in a raffle!" They'll love it.
choice_data_list: Why not send a photo to go with the letter?
Why not send a photo to go with the letter?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ooh, yeah! Nice idea!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right, huddle up 'n bust out your pearly whites!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross throws up a peace sign in front of the carrots. I later find out that her siblings loved the photo.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Just one plain old carrot?! Whatta joke!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But I guess it'll do. Don't matter how much of it ya got—food is food.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I've been let down worse than this. If I had to say, the worst prize I ever got was… Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I got a consolation prize when I was a kid. There I was, all starvin' 'n stuff, when the raffle clerk goes, "Congrats, kiddo! Here's yer necklace!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I figured I could at least chew on the plastic, but it was nasty. I woulda taken a single tiny candy over that junk any day.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So a carrot's not all so bad, yeah? I'll even let ya have the leaves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross graciously gives me the carrot top. It's not much, but it's something.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Tissues?! For what? The bitter tears of defeat?!
choice_data_list: No use crying over spilt milk.
No use crying over spilt milk.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's true! At least I've got tissues to clean up the mess with.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Waaait a minute! If I hadn't won such a dud prize, there'd be nothin' to cry about in da first place!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I'm so dang unlucky… But that's nothin' new for me. My life's always been like this…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross sulks after losing out at the little test of luck…
